column1: Clause  2  :  This  clause  amends  section  3  of  the  Ports  and  Airports  Development  Levy
Act,  No.  18  of  2011  and  the  legal  effect  of  the  section  as  amended  is  to  increase  the  levy
charged  and  levied  in  respect  of  the  cost,  insurance  and  freight  value  of  any  article  referred
to  in  section  2  of  the  Act.
